entry.author: Timaru District Council
entry.summary:
We apologise that our livestream software did stop working so the report titles could not change. Please see below for the reports.

- 12.14pm: 9.9 Adoption of the Terms of Reference for the 2025-2028 Triennium.
- 12.36pm: 9.12 Temporary Road Closure Applications - Section 342 and Schedule 10, Clause 11(e) LGA
- 12.41pm: 9.13 Undersize Stock Underpass Approval Request - Maze Road
- 12.53pm: 9.14 Council Financial Performance Report to 30 April 2026
- 1.07pm Break for lunch, continuing afterwards with Public Excluded.
